segments.text: If you tend to push aside difficult emotions, ignore them or suppress them, the chances are that you are a bottler.
Or, on the other hand, if you tend to hold onto the difficult emotions, ruminate them and get stuck in them.
Chances are that you're a breuda.
For bottlers, see if you can face toward your emotion.
See if you can ask yourself what your emotion is telling you and what the values are in the situation.
If you are a breuda, see if you can label your emotions more effectively.
That gives you healthy distance between yourself and your emotions.
And then again, ask yourself what is the next right step.
